liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **MountainGoats-06-27-12**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]

## The recordings

- **MountainGoats2012-06-27** (recommended): source not stated; 1 songs; 96 min; rated 2/5 by 4 [1]

## Around the show

- Notes that solo John shows are uncommon these days, making this performance stand out [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **MountainGoats2012-06-27**: taped by Lu3ke; source: Zoom H2 [1]. Also: Asks whether the single FLAC file equals the raw .wav, and whether a lossless tracked FLAC of the edited version exists; Reviewer adjusted volume levels and split the raw FLAC into tracks without fades between songs, proposing to share it; Includes the raw .wav as recorded plus 256K VBR MP3s the uploader edited and cleaned up from it [1][3][5]
